evidence_class: Mocked Redis with fakeredis, scoped fixture grants, a fake clock and a fake integration provider. GitHub adapter responses are mocked. No protected branch or deployed system was mutated by these tests.
interfaces: Proposal binds task generation, task revision, pull request URL, tested head and evidence artifact
Outcomes.propose validates a scoped worker grant, current owner, task revision, pull request identity and verified proof before journalling the proposal

Outcomes.integrate reserves a single dispatch and requires current ownership at the provider boundary; it distinguishes accepted, unknown, committed queue admission and externally verified merge outcomes

GitHubIntegration reads actual pull request and merge commit fields, limits operations to the configured repository and dev branch, enqueues the observed expected head and invokes the controller guard immediately before the mutation
Outcomes.outcome_conflicts_total reports proposal, task revision and pull request conflicts
require_local rejects distributed final mutations for tasks with authority or claim journal records; command wiring is unfinished

supported_versions.python: Runtime minimum is 3.11; candidate tests ran on Python 3.12.13
supported_versions.coordination: Existing TaskAuthority scoped grants, task generations, server time, claim journal and Redis transaction fencing
supported_versions.provider: Existing GitHub expectedHeadOid enqueue operation; adapter transport supplied by the controller
supported_versions.compatibility: Existing local done gate behavior remains covered by its unchanged tests

states.observed: Two attempts propose outcomes for the same task; the replaced attempt is rejected and its ambiguous provider operation is retained for current-owner reconciliation
states.accepted: Verified artifact, run identity and tested head are bound to the proposal and persisted in the task claim journal
states.committed: The fixture provider queue operation has an acknowledged queue identity; task authority remains active
states.externally_verified: Mocked PR MERGED state and merge commit permit current-generation task authority completion. No live G3 evidence exists.

rollback_rehearsal.action: Set Outcomes.integration_enabled false; retain accepted proposals for review without starting provider mutations
rollback_rehearsal.proof: Both ordinary pause and pause immediately before the provider guard preserve a retryable accepted proposal; resume dispatches once. Truly ambiguous provider timeouts remain unknown and are never blindly replayed.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: TaskClaim records and claim journal, scoped launch registrations, authoritative ledger task revision, and provider PR and merge commit state are retained
